# Agoda

> > Agoda is a leading online travel booking platform providing accommodation, flights, and travel services globally, with dedicated supplier and partner management tools.

Agoda operates as both a consumer-facing travel marketplace and a B2B platform for suppliers, vendors, and travel service providers. The platform enables property owners, travel partners, and service vendors to register, manage their offerings, and integrate with Agoda's global distribution network.

## Key Topics

- Agoda
- Travel booking platform
- Supplier portal
- Vendor registration
- B2B platform
- Travel services
- Supplier management
- Accommodation providers
- Property management
- Partner integration
- Travel distribution
- Rocketmiles

## Supplier & Partner Resources

- [Agoda Supplier Portal](https://supplier.agoda.com/): B2B portal for Agoda suppliers and vendors to register and manage services
